text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ow, ow...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I'm alright!
I just hurt it a little bit, so...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's get back to training!
I'm so sorry for making you worry!

Mejiro Ryan spoke brightly,
but an injury is still an injury.
choice_data_list: Just to be safe, should we take today off?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
B-But it's really nothing serious, honestly?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: See?! Even right now, squats are totally easy peasy—
Mejiro Ryan started doing squats, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —Ow-ow-owww...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, yes...
I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Y-You're right!
I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"If it'd been a major injury, I wouldn't even
have been able to run in races anymore..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
(――If it were McQueen...
she would never...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Guess I still don't take things
as seriously as I should...
That day, I decided to play it safe and give her some rest, but...

She seemed deeply troubled,
and her injury took a long time to heal...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, you're right!
I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Focus, focus...!
At times like this, use your core and take deep belly breaths!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaaaale, exhaaaaale...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's go!

—Naturally, I put a stop to training,
but she showed signs of recovery by the next day and healed quickly!
